outcome: pediatric-onset immune-mediated inflammatory (pIMID) diagnosis (inflammatory bowel disease, autoimmune hepatitis, primary sclerosing cholangitis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, or systemic lupus erythematosus)
cohort: 1,350,353 children born in Denmark from 1994 to 2014
finding: Children born to women with a preconception IMID diagnosis, children born by Caesarean section, and females had a higher risk of developing pIMID.
mod_finding: Children born by Cesarean section had a higher risk of developing pIMID compared to those born vaginally.
